items.headline: alibaba/open-code-review
items.summary: Open-source & free — Battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in fine-tuned ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

items.headline: NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer

items.headline: Alipay-PIBench: A Realistic Payment Integration Benchmark for Coding Agents
items.summary:
arXiv:2607.14573v3 Announce Type: replace-cross
